_meta.description: The failed-logon reason keyed on three values (EventID, Status, Sub_Status). Enrich matches one field, so the source rows (windows-reason.ndjson) carry a composite key 'event_id|status|substatus' (hex lowercased) and the logs-dxdfir-winlog pipeline builds the same key from winlog.event_id + winlog.data.Status + winlog.data.SubStatus before matching. Fills ECS event.reason (chiefly 4625).
